title: Great little convection oven
text:
Great little convection oven. This thing is a gem. I was kind of leary of a cheap "toaster oven", but this far exceeds my expectations. I've actually made toast in this and it performed well. But the utility of this oven is actually more in the realm of using it as a small convection oven. I've cooked a frozen casserole with it, pot pies, and all kinds of things i would normally have to fire up my larger oven for. The digital temperature control and convection cooking is key. Have not yet done a pizza with it, but no reason it shouldn't excel with that. Just not sure what the max diameter pizza it would hold. Easy cleaning. No regrets. Just note the back and somewhat less so the top can get pretty hot, so make certain you have some clearance for this from combustible materials.

Update: About 6 months in and the LED display started to fail. Individual segment don't light and this has progressed over the 2 years I have had it. It doesn't affect its function otherwise, but I am now guessing the temp and time based on only about half of the segments in the digits. It still works great otherwise, and I may buy another one as a replacement. This aspect has been the only problem, but it could be a big problem and make it unusable if any more LEDs go out. I'll have to downgrade to 2 stars because of this.
